The up-to-$2,000 headline on the merchant-services page requires adding M&T Merchant Services - this route covers the business-checking promo only (up to $1,500).
Online account opening available for sole proprietors only (one owner, no partners); other businesses must visit a branch.
Normal tax treatment applies to bank bonuses (reported as income).
